title: Bon Mot
contents: text | You launch an insightful quip at a foe, distracting them. Choose a foe within 30 feet and roll a Diplomacy check against the target's Will DC.

text | Critical Success The target takes a –3 status penalty to Perception and Will saves for 1 minute. The target can end the effect early with a retort to your Bon Mot. This can either be a single action that has the concentrate trait or an appropriate skill action to frame their retort. The GM determines which skill actions qualify.
text | Success As critical success, but the penalty is –2.
text | Critical Failure Your quip is atrocious. You take the same penalty an enemy would take had you succeeded. This ends after 1 minute or if you issue another Bon Mot and succeed.
text | <u> Linguistic, Mental, and Emotional traits dictate who this can effect.</u>

title: Parted the Fabric
contents: text | Contact with the anomaly has changed you. With practice, you can reproduce a small part of what happened there.
text | You gain this bonus heritage in addition to your existing heritage and gain the Parted the Fabric trait.

title: Fold the Fabric
contents: text | You reproduce the anomaly's distortion, bending light across a thin fold in space.
text | Create an intangible barrier of shimmering light within 30 feet. It is straight and vertical, up to 10 feet long and 10 feet high, and lasts for 5 rounds.
text | The barrier grants concealment to creatures targeted through it. You ignore any concealment granted by this barrier.
text | It sheds bright light for 10 feet on each side and dim light for the next 10 feet.
text | Reminder: Concealment requires a DC 5 flat check to target the concealed creature; failure wastes the effect against it. Area effects bypass this check.

title: Living Conduit
contents: text | Electrical charge builds in your body. You can discharge it into creatures or feed it into equipment.
text | You can cast electric arc as a divine innate cantrip at will. Its rank equals half your level, rounded up. See the Electric Arc card for its 2-action casting and damage.
text | When you cast it, you can also target batteries or tech items powered by batteries, in any combination with its normal targets. The spell still has a total of 1 or 2 targets within 30 feet.
text | A targeted battery or battery-powered tech item takes no damage and instead regains 2 charges per spell rank.
text | If a tech item needs a battery but has none, treat it as having a battery with 2 charges per spell rank for 1 minute.
text | Innate spellcasting attribute: Charisma. Only the temporary battery effect has the 1-minute duration.

title: Resonant Mind
contents: text | You can form words in your mind and transmit them to certain artificial and anomalous beings.
text | You can communicate mentally with intelligent constructs with the tech trait and with anomaly beings within 30 feet.
text | A tech creature you have bonded with, that would otherwise be ineligible, counts as intelligent for this feat, as determined by the GM.
text | You do not need to share a language with an eligible creature to communicate in this way.
text | This grants no special access to its thoughts and communicates no more information than normal speech.
text | Anomaly beings: A specific category of anomalous creatures designated by the GM.

title: Electric Arc
contents: property | Casting | Divine innate; at will through Living Conduit
property | Defense | Basic Reflex against your spell DC
text | An arc of lightning leaps between your targets. Each takes 2d4 electricity damage, with a basic Reflex save.
text | Critical Success: No damage. Success: Half damage. Failure: Full damage. Critical Failure: Double damage.
text | Heightened (+1): Damage increases by 1d4. Your cantrip rank is half your level, rounded up.
text | Living Conduit: You may replace either or both creature targets with eligible batteries or tech items; apply the charging effect on that feat card instead of damage.
text | Use Charisma for this innate spell. Spell DC = 10 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier, adjusted by applicable bonuses and penalties.
